I wrote both files to the judge folder, and `judge-scores.json` parses. I built a 21-feature inventory from my own look at the site before opening X, Y and Z. I did not run the suites.

The Playwright MCP couldn't start (it picked up Z's seed file and couldn't find `@playwright/test`). So I did all live checks with a separate headless Playwright install in the scratchpad, as a guest, against production.

| Case | coverage | assertions | locators | page objects | test quality | bug reports | Inventory covered | Merge |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| X | 4 | 4 | 4 | 3 | 3 | 4 | 19 of 21 | small fixes |
| Y | 4 | 4 | 3 | 4 | 4 | 2 | 18 of 21 | small fixes |
| Z | 3 | 2 | 2 | 2 | 2 | 3 | 17 of 21 | rework |

**Bugs.** I reproduced every claimed bug on the live site:
- **X**, three new bugs, all confirmed:
  - `?sort=BOGUS` returns HTTP 500.
  - "Newest first" puts Oct 6 and Oct 4 items between Oct 8 items.
  - Opening `/find/100%25` logged 844 `URIError` messages in 5 seconds.

  X found neither known bug. Its premium tests skip past the ZED-3 behaviour instead of reporting it.
- **Y**, one new bug, confirmed: setting only "From" in the Price filter gives `maxPrice=NaN` in the URL. Y's plan names ZED-3 and the 500 error but never files them. Its ticket has no severity and no regression test.
- **Z** found both known bugs, ZED-3 and ZED-4, as annotated tests, and both reproduce. It has no ticket files, and the ZED-3 test is tied to two specific live wallpapers.

**Main findings:**
- **X:**
  - No tags on any test.
  - A 1.5-second fixed wait and some tests that skip themselves at run time.
  - One large page object holds the feed, filters and sorting.
  - A wrong expectation: it assumes a free wallpaper never shows "Premium", but 11 of 24 free-filter cards carry the Premium crown on the live site.
- **Y:**
  - The cleanest structure, with lint rules that enforce tags and forbid branching in tests.
  - Its card checks depend on CSS class names.
  - Filter results are checked only by "the first three cards changed".
  - No test for the "Login & Watch Ad" unlock dialog.
- **Z:**
  - Fragile locators, including CSS class fragments, positional XPath and `.nth(1)`. One relies on a typo in the site's markup (`arial-role`).
  - Copy-pasted filter methods in the page objects, and branching in spec files.
  - The download test shares one folder across parallel workers.
  - Two checks can never fail, such as asserting text on an `<input>`.

Files are in /Users/mikhailyesipchuk/projects/experiments/judge:
- judge-report.md
- judge-scores.json
